reason: I already pay an admin who types the receipts into Excel every week. Yes, she's behind, but she still gets it done, and half of what I spend on the scooters is cash to mechanics with no receipt at all, so a bot reading photos only covers part of it.
objection: $19 a month for something my admin already does, and then I have to move everything from her Excel to a Google Sheet and still chase the cash payments by hand.
would_change_my_mind: If my admin ran the free 30 documents on a messy week of fuel and parts receipts and told me it saved her most of a day without errors, I'd pay.
